name: Watermelon Z 40's Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description:
Elevate your pre-roll game. STIIIZY 40's pre-rolls are setting the standard with, cannabis infused joints coated evenly with kief. Using our proprietary live resin infusion methods, we’ve designed every pre-roll to have a unique profile. Each and every STIIIZY 40's is packed with premium, high quality flower specifically made for a quality experience.

WATERMELON Z

TASTE: Sweet, Citrus, Berry

FEELING: Euphoric, Relaxing, Uplifting

DESCRIPTION: This mouthwatering strain is perfect for lazy nights on the couch.

Flavors: Sweet, Tropical, Strawberry
